headline: Frequently Asked Questions
subheadline: Everything you need to know to get started.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Install the CLI with npm, run the init command, and our AI will guide you through setup in under 2 minutes.

items.question: Can I use my own components?
items.answer: Absolutely. Blocks are standard Astro components. You can customize them or create your own from scratch.

items.question: Is there a free tier?
items.answer: Yes! The CLI and all blocks are free and open source. We offer paid plans for premium AI features and priority support.

items.question: What deployment targets are supported?
items.answer: We support Cloudflare Workers, Pages, and Vercel out of the box. Custom adapters can be added for other platforms.

items.question: How does i18n work?
items.answer: Content is organized by locale in content collections. Add a locale and the AI generates culturally appropriate content automatically.
